items.question: TCS reported other income of ₹4,402 crore in its FY2025-26 consolidated statement of profit and loss. What does the note behind that line say it consists of?

required_claims: Interest income is the largest component of other income.
Interest on financial assets carried at fair value through OCI is the largest component of interest income.
Net foreign exchange was a loss in FY2025-26, against a gain in FY2024-25.

items.question: TCS's FY2025-26 consolidated statement of profit and loss shows total tax expense of ₹16,033 crore on profit before tax of ₹65,487 crore. How does the income taxes note reconcile the tax expected at the statutory rate to that figure?

required_claims: Expected income tax expense is computed at the Indian statutory income tax rate.
Tax pertaining to prior years reduced the reported tax expense below the expected amount.
Tax on income at different rates increased the tax expense.

items.question: TCS's FY2025-26 consolidated statement of profit and loss shows re-structuring expenses of ₹1,388 crore under exceptional items. What does the note behind that line say they were, and how much of the amount was utilized during the year?

required_claims: The Group announced re-structuring initiatives in July 2025.
The expenses are termination benefits for associates released from the organisation whose deployment may not be feasible.
They are presented as exceptional items because of their size, nature or occurrence.

items.question: What final dividend did TCS's Board propose for the year ended March 31, 2026, and what cash outflow would it result in?

required_claims: The Board of Directors proposed the final dividend on April 9, 2026.
The dividend is subject to the approval of shareholders at the Annual General Meeting.

items.question: What does TCS's FY2025-26 Management Discussion and Analysis report about employee attrition and learning in FY 2026?

required_claims: The 13.7% figure is voluntary attrition in IT services.
Associates completed a total of 69 million learning hours in FY 2026.
Learning intensity rose 25% year-on-year to 120 hours per associate per year.

items.question: RIL reported other income of ₹28,962 crore in its FY2025-26 consolidated statement of profit and loss. What does the note behind that line say it consists of?

required_claims: Interest is the largest component of other income.
Interest on bank deposits is the largest component of interest income.
Dividend income rose sharply from FY2024-25.

items.question: RIL's FY2025-26 consolidated statement of profit and loss shows current tax of ₹9,736 crore and deferred tax of ₹17,816 crore. How does the taxation note reconcile these to the tax computed at the applicable rate, and what effective tax rate does it report?

required_claims: Additional allowances / deductions were the largest item reducing the current tax provision below the computed tax.
Utilisation of carried forward losses also reduced the current tax provision.
The deferred tax provision arose mainly from incremental deferred tax liability on property, plant and equipment and other intangible assets.

items.question: According to RIL's FY2025-26 Management Discussion and Analysis, which business segment's EBITDA declined year-on-year, by how much, and why?

required_claims: The Oil and Gas segment's EBITDA declined, by 10.1% year-on-year.
The decline was in line with natural decline in production in the KG D6 block.
Softer gas prices also contributed to the decline.

items.question: REMC Limited reported other income of ₹660.16 lakh in its FY2024-25 statement of profit and loss. What does the note behind that line say it consists of?

required_claims: Interest earned on deposits with banks is the largest component of other income.
Rental income is a component of other income.
Miscellaneous income includes sale of tender documents, penalties or compensation received, and profit on sale of fixed assets.

items.question: REMC Limited reported revenue from operations of ₹13,386.75 lakh in its FY2024-25 statement of profit and loss. What does the note behind that line show about its composition?

required_claims: Consultancy fee is the larger revenue stream, ahead of power generation (sale of electrical energy).
Consultancy fee is reported net of Goods and Services Tax.
Both consultancy fee and sale of electrical energy include an unbilled revenue component.

items.question: According to REMC Limited's Directors' Report for FY2024-25, why did total income and profit before tax decrease compared with FY2023-24?

required_claims: Generation from the Jaisalmer Wind Power Plant was reduced.
RE-RTC bids were non-responsive because the expected CTUIL connectivity period was beyond the bid timelines for project execution.
